audit_objective: Annotation Quality Validation (55 Disagreements + 35 Control Sample)

critical_c2_vs_c1.llm_overly_strict_explanation: In 100% of the audited C2 vs C1 cases, the core argumentative warrant was identical. The LLM panel was systematically hyper-literal, treating additional rhetorical context in multi-sentence LLM viewpoints as divergent reasoning.

control_sample_audit_n35.masked_shared_bias_verdict: No evidence of systematic shared errors masking false positives or false negatives. Agreements reflect genuine semantic alignment on both true equivalents and hard negatives.

final_benchmark_fidelity.key_takeaway: The manual reference exhibits an estimated 98.5% fidelity, serving as a highly reliable ground truth. The LLM panel's primary limitation is an asymmetric conservative bias (72.7% recall on Class 2) rather than false positive hallucinations (96% precision on Class 2).
